''See also: [[Steel Avalanche Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|[[steel|Steel]] Avalanche is a gray-bearded human and a member of the [[Advocate]] High [[Council]]. A formidable combatant, he possesses the ability to utilize high-level [[Combat Arts]] and wields [[Aethertech]] gauntlets that extend from his forearms to his hands. These specialized gauntlets generate intense power, which he can direct through his strikes; however, improper use of the technology is lethal to the user and destructive to their surroundings. In combat, he has demonstrated the ability to manipulate [[water]] drawn from the [[Aether]], even splitting through whirlpools. Although he has survived near-fatal encounters, such as being trapped in a [[water]] vortex, he is known for his brutal fighting style and has previously been tasked with hunting others after a violent confrontation involving the [[Nebula Runners]]. Despite his status as a Councilor, he has been characterized by some as a violent criminal.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|This broad human is characterized by a gray beard. He wears a [[blue-and-white uniform]] featuring the [[Advocate]] 'A' alongside silver [[Aethertech]] gauntlets that extend from his forearms down.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|As a member of [[the Advocates]]' Low [[Council]], he is an enemy of the narrator who would have ended the narrator's life if able. He is a guard who finds watching prisoners to be an unpleasant task and has expressed approval regarding [[Starhammer]]'s speech.}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|[[steel|Steel]] Avalanche is an enemy of the narrator, whom he would have killed if possible. He also expressed approval regarding a speech delivered by [[Starhammer]].}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|He utilizes [[Aethertech]] weapons and gauntlets that emit a [[sapphire]] light. Through a [[Combat Art]], he can direct the force of his punches to strike opponents into ceilings.}}

== History ==
=== {{spoiler|book=lh-02-the-engineer|The Engineer}} ===
{{spoiler|book=lh-02-the-engineer|As a new member of [[the Advocates]]’ Low [[Council]], [[steel|Steel]] Avalanche wears a [[blue-and-white uniform]] featuring the [[Advocate]] ‘A’ and silver [[Aethertech]] gauntlets.<ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c11">''The Engineer'', chapter 11</ref> A genuine fighter capable of punching individuals into ceilings, this broad, gray-bearded human serves as an enemy to the narrator.<ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c11" /><ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c23">''The Engineer'', chapter 23</ref> His [[Aethertech]] gauntlets cover him from the forearms down and emit a [[sapphire]] light.<ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c23" /><ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c51">''The Engineer'', chapter 51</ref> Now an [[Advocate]] [[High Councilor]], this gray-bearded man once killed the [[Nebula Runners]] and utilizes an [[Aethertech weapon]].<ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c28">''The Engineer'', chapter 28</ref> After expressing approval of [[Starhammer]]'s speech, he is noted as a guard who dislikes watching prisoners.<ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c42">''The Engineer'', chapter 42</ref><ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c51" /> He possesses a [[Combat Art]] that allows him to direct the force of his punches and would have killed the narrator if given the opportunity.<ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c49">''The Engineer'', chapter 49</ref><ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c51" />}}
